hero.subtitle: Tylicz · 600 m from the ski slope
hero.text: 71 m² for up to 9 guests: 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a fully equipped kitchen and free parking. The slope is an 8-minute walk away, the market square 5 minutes.

about.title: Room for the whole family or a group of friends
about.text: A newly furnished apartment in Tylicz, one of the most popular ski resorts in Poland's Beskid Sądecki mountains. Everyone gets their own bedroom, and three bathrooms mean no morning queues. Free ski buses run through the village.

items.a: Check-in 15:00–18:00 (please let us know your arrival time in advance). Check-out 8:00–11:00.
Children of all ages are welcome. A baby cot (0–3 years) is free of charge. Extra beds are not available.
Free private parking on site (no reservation needed). Free WiFi throughout the apartment.
Smoking is not allowed anywhere in the apartment. No parties, hen or stag events.

faqSchema.q: How far is the ski slope?
faqSchema.a: The Master Ski Family slope is just 600 metres from the apartment, and Tylicz Ski is 2.2 km away. Free ski buses run through the village.

faqSchema.q: How many people does the apartment sleep?
faqSchema.a: The apartment comfortably sleeps up to 9 people in 3 bedrooms, with 3 private bathrooms.
Yes. Free private parking is available on site and does not need to be reserved.
Krynica-Zdrój is about 10 km from Tylicz, roughly a 15-minute drive.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaTitle: Privacy policy — Apartament za Rynkiem, Tylicz

p: Your personal data is controlled by Patryk Wyszyński, who rents out Apartament za Rynkiem, Kopernika 11, 33-383 Tylicz, Poland. Contact: {email}, phone {phone}.

sections.h: What data we process and why
p: When you contact us by phone, email or WhatsApp, we process the data you give us (e.g. your name, phone number, email address, dates of stay, number of guests and your message). We do this to answer your enquiry and handle your booking (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), to meet legal obligations such as tax rules (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR) and, if necessary, to pursue claims (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

The “Ask about your dates” form does not send any data to our server. Clicking a button opens your email program or WhatsApp with the message ready, and you send it from there. If you use WhatsApp, your data is also processed by Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. under its privacy policy.
This site does not collect visitor statistics and uses no advertising or marketing tools.
Hosting: the site is served by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). The server may log IP addresses and browser details for security purposes.

Google Maps: the “Location” section shows a Google map (Google Ireland Ltd.). Once it loads, Google may set cookies and process your IP address, including outside the European Economic Area. Details: policies.google.com/privacy.
Icons: some icons on the site are loaded from Iconify (api.iconify.design), which receives your browser's IP address.
Bookings made through Booking.com are covered by Booking.com's privacy policy.
We keep enquiry data for as long as needed to reply and to handle your stay. Data required by tax law is kept for the period that law requires (usually 5 years).

You have the right to access, correct, delete and port your data, to restrict its processing and to object to it. To use these rights, email {email}. You may also lodge a complaint with the Polish data protection authority (Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw).

The site itself does not use cookies. It only stores a note in your browser's local storage that you closed the map notice, so it isn't shown again. The Google map described above may set cookies. You can delete or block them in your browser settings.
